import subprocess,json,os
cases=[('positive',{'a':2,'b':3},5),('negative',{'a':-8,'b':3},-5),('decimal',{'a':1.25,'b':2.5},3.75),('zero',{'a':0,'b':0},0),('missing',{'a':2},None),('wrong-type',{'a':'two','b':3},None)]
results=[]
for label,args,expected in cases:
 cmd=['npm','exec','--yes','--package=@mcpjam/cli@6.2.2','--','mcpjam','tools','call','--url','http://fixture:8765/mcp','--access-token',os.environ['MCP_SERVER_TOKEN'],'--tool-name','add','--tool-args',json.dumps(args),'--format','json']
 p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
 try:r=json.loads(p.stdout)
 except ValueError:r={'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr}
 ok=(r.get('structuredContent',{}).get('sum')==expected and not r.get('isError',False)) if expected is not None else (p.returncode!=0 or r.get('isError',False) or 'error' in r)
 results.append({'case':label,'arguments':args,'expected':expected,'passed':ok,'exitCode':p.returncode,'response':r})
json.dump(results,open('/workspace/validation/arithmetic-results.json','w'),indent=2)
print(json.dumps(results))
